name: @maydayv/vibecoding-plus
description: Voice-driven AI coding bridge and macOS desktop app for ESP32 e-paper devices with Inject, Codex, and Claude modes.

scripts.native:generate: cd client/macos-native && if command -v xcodegen >/dev/null 2>&1; then xcodegen generate; else echo 'xcodegen not found; using checked-in Xcode project'; fi
scripts.native:build: npm run native:generate && cd client/macos-native && xcodebuild -project VibeCodingPlusNative.xcodeproj -scheme VibeCodingPlusNative -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=macOS' build

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: VibeCoding Plus uses the microphone for local push-to-talk voice input.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: VibeCoding Plus uses Apple Events to inject transcribed text into the active application when Inject mode is enabled.
extendInfo.NSRemindersUsageDescription: VibeCoding Plus can read and update Reminders when Apple Reminders sync is enabled.
